release_status: implementation recommendation, not deployed or balance-certified

movement.selection: room host selects before first grant; same for all participants; no midgame change
movement.status: recommended room rule; legacy printed instructions permit choosing one or two dice
movement.rng: server fair independent d6, persisted once per semantic roll ID; animation replays result
movement.overshoot: clamp at final cutoff; discard surplus steps; no final landing offer
movement.backward: position may change but financial progress never reverses; no backward movement in baseline catalog

timeline.college_eligibility: scenario tag and authored status, never inferred from lap number alone
timeline.ten_laps: extended planning horizon, not ten seasons of NCAA eligibility
timeline.horizon_status: recommended game duration cap, not real eligibility determination
timeline.extended_phase: after5completedlaps college-dependentdraws excluded; generalprofessional/lifestyle scenarios remain

landing_consumption: one committed category purchase/response consumes opportunity; browsing/declining consumes no funds; decline ends turn
deadline: before next own movement roll; final deadline Finish and Reveal
choice_timeout: none; reading or disconnection never selects for player
group_disconnect: retain active turn and resume; host may pause or explicitly remove unfinished player, never submit choices or finish them; no timed autoplay

finance.mutations: lock player and affected company; freeze after finish

coach.debit: only once after usable advice delivered, cached per decision revision
coach.failure: no debit; curated authored guidance fallback
coach.scope: visible committed facts and tradeoffs only, no hidden outcome access or guaranteed escape

voice.voice_confirm: transcribe optional response; map only to allowed authored action; show selected action and require tap confirmation

finish.portfolio_pie: nonnegative asset holdings only; debt separate; no death benefit or points in asset pie

request_contract.money_source: server quote, never client submitted amount as authority
request_contract.auth: authenticated player may mutate own player only; host can configure room but cannot spend participant money

event_contract.exactly_once: natural key unique independently of operation_id; same key different payload rejects; outbox after committed receipt

phase_plan.name: Current Sidekick compatibility inventory
phase_plan.scope: export settings and schemas; compare card IDs and saved records; no guessed migration

phase_plan.name: Central ledger and catalog increments
phase_plan.scope: cash/debt/tax/quote/sale/fixed contracts and supported new catalogs
phase_plan.gate: actual persistence tests match reference fixtures

phase_plan.name: Connected scenario vertical slice
phase_plan.scope: one complete flow of each color, coach,pressure,career,luxury and reveal

phase_plan.name: Standalone live digital board
phase_plan.scope: authoritative movement, six players, shared company offers and reconnection

phase_plan.name: Content and balance expansion
phase_plan.scope: enable full reviewed libraries, tune pacing, later industries and tournament presentation
phase_plan.gate: six starting tiers and both lengths evaluated; no wealth winner by default

ai_boundary: narrates committed facts only; no balances, rates, odds, eligibility, scores or class thresholds authored live
